richiami.difetto: The screws that anchor the safety belts or the locking brackets of the rear bench seat backrest may not have been tightened in accordance with the specifications. In the event of a crash, vehicle occupants may therefore not be protected. There is a risk of injury. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown

richiami.difetto: ​​This safety recall involves bolts which fix the left and right side rear seat safety belts to the vehicle body or bolts which fix the rear bench seat configuration backrest locking brackets to the vehicle body. One of these bolts may not have been tightened to specifications and over time could loosen and also potentially cause damage to either the left or right side rear seat safety belt webbing.​
richiami.modello: BLACK BADGE CULLINAN , BLACK BADGE CULLINAN
richiami.rimedio: ​​The possibly affected fixing bolts will be checked and either tightened to specifications or replaced as necessary.  The condition of the left and right side rear seat safety belts will be checked and if necessary replaced.​
richiami.titolo: RR31 Rear Seat Belt Bolt Connection Check

richiami.difetto: The signal contact of the engine position sensor of the integrated braking system can be compromised, leading to an unexpected failure of the hydraulic braking assistance, thereby requiring greater pressure on the pedal and resulting in a longer braking distance and a failure of the anti-lock braking system and of the dynamic stability control system. This can increase the risk of accidents and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown

Ciò può aumentare il rischio di incidenti e lesioni. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla omologazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

richiami.difetto: The fuel tank feed line connection that is pre-fitted at the supplier to the fuel pump may not be fitted correctly.
richiami.rimedio: The fuel tank will need to be lowered and the fuel line feed connection to be checked and refitted as necessary.

richiami.rimedio: The Auxiliary Water Pump of the affected vehicles will be replaced.

richiami.difetto: The Head airbag may have been damaged during installation. As a result the airbag may not deploy correctly after activation.
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehicles inspect and where necessary relace the Head airbag module
richiami.titolo: HEAD AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: It has been identified by the manufacturer that the air-bag initiator does not meet specification. This can therefore result in the initiator not functioning correctly which can lead to none deployment of the air-bag. Should a collision occur then there is an increased risk of injury to the occupants of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the air-bags with a new quality assured component.
richiami.titolo: FRONT MOUNTED SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY IN A COLLISION

richiami.difetto: null The airbag central sensor has been programmed with faulty software. In the event of an accident requiring activation of the passive safety systems, the seat-belt tensioner, front airbags and active head restraints will not be activated, increasing the risk of injury to the occupants.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: Type: Ghost Family; EC type-approval: e11*2007/46*0101*12
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: null The airbag central sensor has been programmed with faulty software.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the airbag/SRS central sensor has been programmed with faulty software. If the vehicle is involved in a frontal or rearward collision then the airbag and seat belt tensioners may not be triggered which could lead to an increased risk of injury to the occupants.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles for the replacement of the airbag/SRS central sensor.
richiami.titolo: FRONT AIRBAGS AND BELT TENSIONERS MAY NOT BE TRIGGERED IN A COLLISON

richiami.difetto: The side curtain air bags for both left and right sides of the vehicle may not have been produced to specification. It is possible for the side curtain air bag may not position itself as intended during a collision thereby further increasing the risk of injury to the occupants.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect the side curtain air bags on both left and right of the vehicle. Where necessary the side curtain air bag will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: SIDE CURTAIN AIRBAGS MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: null A defective pump casing for the auxiliary coolant pump of the exhaust-gas turbocharger can cause cracking and, if cooling liquid penetrates the casing, a short circuit or smouldering could occur. In the event of smouldering damage, a fire in the engine or even a vehicle fire cannot be completely excluded.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: Type RR4, EC type approval e11*2007/46*0101
richiami.titolo: null A defective pump casing for the auxiliary coolant pump of the exhaust-gas turbocharger can cause cracking and, if cooling liquid penetrates the casing, a…

richiami.difetto: Some engines are fitted with an additional water pump for the turbo charger. In some circumstances a crack may develop which then leads to melting of the plug connections and the housing. Further heat development may then lead to scorch damage. In exceptional cases such overheating can lead to smouldering of the water pump.  If smouldering occurs an engine compartment fire and vehicle fire cannot be excluded.
richiami.rimedio: The water pump will be replaced for a new more robust version.
richiami.titolo: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR

richiami.difetto: null The auxiliary coolant pump may fail at high operating temperatures. In a few rare cases there may be smouldering of the auxiliary coolant pump. If so, an engine compartment fire or even a vehicle fire could occur.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: Type RR4, EC type approval e11*2007/46*0101
richiami.titolo: null The auxiliary coolant pump may fail at high operating temperatures.

richiami.difetto: Due to the ingress of moisture it is possible that a short circuit can occur in the additional coolant pump for the exhaust turbocharger. The driver will be informed of the issue by a warning message on the display in the instrument panel.  If not addressed it is possible for further heat build up in the pump which may cause the plug connection and housing to melt and in extreme cases a localised fire in the engine compartment or vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles for the replacement of the additional coolant pump.
richiami.titolo: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR

richiami.difetto: It is possible that engine oil can enter the brake servo via the brake vacuum pump and vacuum hose. If this occurs it could damage the brake servo membrane which may leak so causing a reduction in braking assistance and a requirement to apply increased pedal force to achieve the same braking efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles for the fitment of a modified servo hose. In addition the checking of the brake servo for contamination and replacement if required.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE REDUCTION IN BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: The low pressure brake fluid feed pipe between the master cylinder and remote reservoir has the potential to trap air which may in certain circumstances cause partial failure of the primary brake circuit.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace both brake fluid feed hoses and reservoir with a new assembly to a revised specification.
richiami.titolo: AIR CAN ENTER PRIMARY CIRCUIT OF BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER

richiami.difetto: The low pressure brake fluid feed pipe between the master cylinder and remote reservoir has the potential to trap air which may in certain circumstances cause partial failure of the primary brake circuit.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace both brake fluid feed hoses and reservoir with a new assembly to a revised specification.
richiami.titolo: AIR CAN ENTER PRIMARY CIRCUIT OF BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER

richiami.difetto: On the vehicles affected the potential exists for the surface of each heated seat to reach an unacceptably high temperature. In extreme cases this could cause damage to anything in contact with the seat cushion.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit an additional control unit to each heated seat.
richiami.titolo: HEATED SEATS MAY REACH AN UNACCEPTABLY HIGH TEMPERATURE

richiami.difetto: During manufacture the braking systems were filled with mineral oil from identified batches which could have an adverse effect on braking performance.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles to have the braking systems drained and filled with new mineral oil.
richiami.titolo: INCORRECT OIL IN BRAKING SYSTEM
